decisions.choice: the fire of God: fire sent by God
decisions.reason: The fire is called God's own, which says plainly who sent it. The phrase is used of lightning in Job 1:16, and it may mean lightning here as well.

decisions.choice: to them ... the man of God: small differences from verse 10
decisions.reason: Elijah speaks "to them", the commander and his men together, and says "the man of God" with the article, as though taking up the title they have used of him. The sense of his answer is the same as in verse 10.

decisions.choice: fell (Balanced); God sent fire down from heaven, and it burned up (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says the fire of God "fell", a natural word for fire from the sky. Readable makes God the subject, which is what "the fire of God" means.

source.text: וַיָּ֗שָׁב וַיִּשְׁלַ֛ח שַׂר־חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים שְׁלִשִׁ֖ים וַחֲמִשָּׁ֑יו וַיַּ֡עַל וַיָּבֹא֩ שַׂר־הַחֲמִשִּׁ֨ים הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֜י וַיִּכְרַ֥ע עַל־בִּרְכָּ֣יו׀לְנֶ֣גֶד אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיִּתְחַנֵּ֤ן אֵלָיו֙ וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֵלָ֔יו אִ֚ישׁ הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים תִּֽיקַר־נָ֣א נַפְשִׁ֗י וְנֶ֨פֶשׁ עֲבָדֶ֥יךָֽ אֵ֛לֶּה חֲמִשִּׁ֖ים בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he again sent [a] commander of fifty, third, and his fifty; and went up and came [the] commander of the fifty, the third, and bent on his knees before Elijah and sought favor from him, and spoke to him, man of God, let be precious please my life and [the] life of your servants these fifty in your eyes.

en.L: And he again sent a third commander of fifty and his fifty. And the third commander of fifty went up and came and knelt on his knees before Elijah, and pleaded with him and said to him, "Man of God, please let my life and the life of these fifty, your servants, be precious in your eyes.
en.B: Then the king sent a third commander of fifty with his fifty men. This third commander went up, fell on his knees before Elijah and pleaded with him: "Man of God, please let my life, and the lives of these fifty servants of yours, be precious to you.
en.R: The king sent a third commander with his fifty soldiers. This third commander went up and knelt down in front of Elijah. He begged him, "Man of God, please spare my life and the lives of these fifty servants of yours.

es.L: Y volvió a enviar un tercer jefe de cincuenta y sus cincuenta. Y subió y llegó el tercer jefe de cincuenta, y se puso de rodillas delante de Elías, y le suplicó y le dijo: «Hombre de Dios, te ruego que sea preciosa a tus ojos mi vida y la vida de estos cincuenta siervos tuyos.
es.B: Entonces el rey envió un tercer jefe de cincuenta con sus cincuenta hombres. Este tercer jefe subió, cayó de rodillas delante de Elías y le suplicó: «Hombre de Dios, te ruego que mi vida y la vida de estos cincuenta siervos tuyos sean valiosas para ti.
es.R: El rey envió un tercer jefe con sus cincuenta soldados. Este tercer jefe subió y se arrodilló delante de Elías. Le rogó: «Hombre de Dios, por favor, perdónanos la vida a mí y a estos cincuenta siervos tuyos.

fr.L: Et il envoya de nouveau un troisième chef de cinquante et ses cinquante. Et le troisième chef de cinquante monta et vint, et il plia les genoux devant Élie, et le supplia et lui dit : « Homme de Dieu, que ma vie, je t’en prie, et la vie de ces cinquante, tes serviteurs, soient précieuses à tes yeux !
fr.B: Le roi envoya encore un troisième chef de cinquante avec ses cinquante hommes. Ce troisième chef monta, tomba à genoux devant Élie et le supplia : « Homme de Dieu, je t’en prie, que ma vie et celle de ces cinquante hommes, tes serviteurs, aient du prix à tes yeux !
fr.R: Le roi a envoyé un troisième officier avec ses cinquante soldats. Ce troisième officier est monté et s’est mis à genoux devant Élie. Il l’a supplié : « Homme de Dieu, je t’en prie, épargne ma vie et celle de ces cinquante hommes qui sont tes serviteurs !

sw.L: Akatuma tena mkuu wa hamsini wa tatu pamoja na hamsini wake. Yule mkuu wa hamsini wa tatu akapanda, akaja, akapiga magoti mbele ya Eliya, akamsihi, akamwambia, "Mtu wa Mungu, tafadhali, uhai wangu na uhai wa hawa hamsini, watumishi wako, na uwe wa thamani machoni pako.
sw.B: Kisha mfalme alimtuma mkuu wa tatu wa kikosi cha watu hamsini pamoja na watu wake hamsini. Mkuu huyo wa tatu akapanda, akapiga magoti mbele ya Eliya, akamsihi, "Mtu wa Mungu, tafadhali, uhai wangu na uhai wa hawa watumishi wako hamsini uwe na thamani kwako.
sw.R: Mfalme akamtuma kamanda wa tatu pamoja na askari wake hamsini. Kamanda huyo wa tatu akapanda, akapiga magoti mbele ya Eliya. Akamsihi, "Mtu wa Mungu, tafadhali uniachie uhai wangu na uhai wa hawa watumishi wako hamsini.

vi.L: Vua lại sai một viên chỉ huy năm mươi người thứ ba cùng năm mươi người của ông ta. Viên chỉ huy năm mươi người thứ ba đi lên, đến quỳ gối trước mặt Ê-li, nài xin Ê-li và nói: "Thưa người của Đức Chúa Trời, xin cho mạng sống của tôi và mạng sống của năm mươi người này, là đầy tớ của ông, được quý trọng trước mắt ông.
vi.B: Vua lại sai viên chỉ huy năm mươi người thứ ba dẫn năm mươi quân lính của mình đi. Viên chỉ huy thứ ba này đi lên, quỳ gối trước mặt Ê-li và nài xin: "Thưa người của Đức Chúa Trời, xin ông quý trọng mạng sống của tôi và mạng sống của năm mươi người này, là đầy tớ của ông.
vi.R: Vua sai viên chỉ huy thứ ba dẫn năm mươi binh lính đi. Viên chỉ huy thứ ba này đi lên và quỳ xuống trước mặt Ê-li. Ông ta van xin: "Thưa người của Đức Chúa Trời, xin ông tha mạng cho tôi và cho năm mươi người đầy tớ của ông đây.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 다시 셋째 오십부장과 그의 오십 명을 보냈다. 그리고 셋째 오십부장이 올라가서 엘리야 앞에 무릎을 꿇고 그에게 간청하며 그에게 말했다. "하나님의 사람이시여, 제발 제 목숨과 어른의 종들인 이 오십 명의 목숨을 어른의 눈에 귀하게 여겨 주십시오.
ko.B: 왕이 셋째 오십부장과 그의 부하 오십 명을 보냈다. 이 셋째 오십부장은 올라가서 엘리야 앞에 무릎을 꿇고 간청했다. "하나님의 사람이시여, 제발 제 목숨과 어른의 종인 이 오십 명의 목숨을 귀하게 여겨 주십시오.
ko.R: 왕이 세 번째로 지휘관 한 사람을 군인 오십 명과 함께 보냈다. 이 세 번째 지휘관은 올라가서 엘리야 앞에 무릎을 꿇었다. 그리고 그에게 빌었다. "하나님의 사람이시여, 제발 제 목숨과 어른의 종인 이 오십 명의 목숨을 살려 주십시오.

decisions.choice: let my life be precious in your eyes: value my life and spare it
decisions.reason: Something precious in a person's eyes is something they will not throw away (1 Samuel 26:21, 24). The commander asks Elijah not to call down fire on him.

decisions.choice: knelt and pleaded: the third commander comes humbly
decisions.reason: Unlike the first two, he gives no order in the king's name. He kneels before the prophet and asks for mercy, and so he and his men are spared.

decisions.choice: your servants
decisions.reason: A polite way of speaking of oneself and one's men to someone of higher standing, as with "your servant" in Genesis 18:3. It is "your servants" at every level.

decisions.choice: please spare my life
decisions.reason: Readable states what "let my life be precious in your eyes" asks for.

decisions.choice: siervos tuyos
decisions.reason: The polite way of speaking of oneself and one's men to someone of higher standing is "siervo" at every level, as "tu siervo" is in Samuel.

decisions.choice: perdónanos la vida
decisions.reason: Readable states what "let my life be precious in your eyes" asks for, as the English "spare my life".

decisions.choice: "thưa ... ông"; himself "tôi" and his men "đầy tớ của ông"
decisions.reason: The third commander comes humbly (m2): he speaks to the prophet as a respected elder, with the polite "thưa", and calls his men the prophet's servants.

decisions.choice: The third commander pleads in 합쇼체, calls Elijah "하나님의 사람이시여" and "어른", and his men "어른의 종들"
decisions.reason: A humble petitioner speaks 합쇼체 to the prophet; Korean avoids "당신" to a respected elder, and "어른" is the address the Samuel drafts use for Samuel.

decisions.choice: "목숨을 살려 주십시오" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the idiom is given its sense: spare my life (m1).

source.text: הִ֠נֵּה יָ֤רְדָה אֵשׁ֙ מִן־הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וַ֠תֹּאכַל אֶת־שְׁנֵ֞י שָׂרֵ֧י הַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים הָרִאשֹׁנִ֖ים וְאֶת־חֲמִשֵּׁיהֶ֑ם וְעַתָּ֕ה תִּיקַ֥ר נַפְשִׁ֖י בְּעֵינֶֽיךָ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Behold, came down fire from the heavens and consumed [the] two commanders of the fifties, the first ones, and their fifties; and now let be precious my life in your eyes.

en.L: Look, fire came down from the heavens and consumed the first two commanders of fifty and their fifties; and now, let my life be precious in your eyes."
en.B: Fire has come down from heaven and consumed the first two commanders of fifty and their fifty men. But now let my life be precious to you."
en.R: Fire came down from heaven and burned up the first two commanders and all their soldiers. But now, please spare my life!"

es.L: He aquí que descendió fuego de los cielos y consumió a los dos primeros jefes de cincuenta y a sus cincuenta; y ahora, sea preciosa mi vida a tus ojos».
es.B: Ya bajó fuego del cielo y consumió a los dos primeros jefes de cincuenta con sus cincuenta hombres. Pero ahora, que mi vida sea valiosa para ti».
es.R: Ya bajó fuego del cielo y quemó a los dos primeros jefes con todos sus soldados. ¡Pero ahora, por favor, perdóname la vida!».

fr.L: Voici, le feu est descendu des cieux et a dévoré les deux premiers chefs de cinquante et leurs cinquante ; et maintenant, que ma vie soit précieuse à tes yeux ! »
fr.B: Le feu est descendu du ciel et a dévoré les deux premiers chefs de cinquante avec leurs cinquante hommes. Mais maintenant, que ma vie ait du prix à tes yeux ! »
fr.R: Le feu est descendu du ciel et a brûlé les deux premiers officiers et tous leurs soldats. Mais maintenant, je t’en prie, épargne ma vie ! »

sw.L: Tazama, moto ulishuka kutoka mbinguni ukawateketeza wale wakuu wawili wa kwanza wa hamsini pamoja na hamsini zao; na sasa, uhai wangu na uwe wa thamani machoni pako."
sw.B: Moto umeshuka kutoka mbinguni ukawateketeza wakuu wawili wa kwanza wa vikosi vya hamsini pamoja na watu wao. Lakini sasa uhai wangu na uwe na thamani kwako."
sw.R: Moto ulishuka kutoka mbinguni ukawateketeza makamanda wawili wa kwanza na askari wao wote. Lakini sasa, tafadhali uniachie uhai wangu!"

vi.L: Kìa, lửa từ trời đã xuống thiêu nuốt hai viên chỉ huy năm mươi người trước cùng năm mươi người của họ. Nhưng bây giờ, xin cho mạng sống của tôi được quý trọng trước mắt ông."
vi.B: Lửa từ trời đã xuống thiêu nuốt hai viên chỉ huy năm mươi người trước cùng quân lính của họ. Nhưng giờ đây, xin ông quý trọng mạng sống của tôi."
vi.R: Lửa từ trời đã xuống thiêu rụi hai viên chỉ huy trước cùng tất cả binh lính của họ. Nhưng bây giờ, xin ông tha mạng cho tôi!"

ko.L: 보십시오, 하늘에서 불이 내려와 앞의 두 오십부장과 그들의 오십 명들을 삼켰습니다. 그러나 이제 제 목숨을 어른의 눈에 귀하게 여겨 주십시오."
ko.B: 하늘에서 불이 내려와 앞의 두 오십부장과 그들의 부하 오십 명씩을 삼켜 버렸습니다. 그러나 이제 제 목숨만은 귀하게 여겨 주십시오."
ko.R: 하늘에서 불이 내려와 앞의 두 지휘관과 그들의 군인들을 모두 태워 버렸습니다. 그러나 이번에는 제발 제 목숨을 살려 주십시오!"

decisions.choice: and now: a plea set against what has happened
decisions.reason: "Behold" points to the fate of the first two units, and "and now" turns to the request. The commander knows what happened to the others and asks to be treated differently.

decisions.choice: "Look" left out at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The pointing word is kept at Literal. Balanced and Readable state the fact plainly.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֞ר מַלְאַ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ אֶל־אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ רֵ֣ד אוֹת֔וֹ אַל־תִּירָ֖א מִפָּנָ֑יו וַיָּ֛קָם וַיֵּ֥רֶד אוֹת֖וֹ אֶל־הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke [the] angel of Yahweh to Elijah, go down with him, not be afraid of him; and he arose and went down with him to the king.

en.L: And the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said to Elijah, "Go down with him; do not be afraid of him." And he arose and went down with him to the king.
en.B: The angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told Elijah, "Go down with him, and have no fear of him." So Elijah rose and went down with him to the king.
en.R: Then the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} told Elijah, "Go down with him, and do not be afraid of him." Elijah got up and went with the commander to the king.

es.L: Y el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} dijo a Elías: «Baja con él; no tengas miedo de él». Y se levantó y bajó con él al rey.
es.B: El ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} le dijo a Elías: «Baja con él, y no le tengas miedo». Entonces Elías se levantó y bajó con él a ver al rey.
es.R: Entonces el ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} le dijo a Elías: «Baja con él, y no tengas miedo de él». Elías se levantó y fue con el jefe a ver al rey.

fr.L: Et l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dit à Élie : « Descends avec lui ; n’aie pas peur de lui. » Et il se leva et descendit avec lui vers le roi.
fr.B: L’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} dit à Élie : « Descends avec lui, et ne le crains pas. » Élie se leva donc et descendit avec lui auprès du roi.
fr.R: Alors l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} a dit à Élie : « Descends avec lui, et n’aie pas peur de lui. » Élie s’est levé et il est allé avec l’officier chez le roi.

sw.L: Malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Eliya, "Shuka pamoja naye; usimwogope." Akainuka, akashuka pamoja naye kwa mfalme.
sw.B: Malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimwambia Eliya, "Shuka pamoja naye, wala usimwogope." Basi Eliya akainuka, akashuka pamoja naye kwa mfalme.
sw.R: Kisha malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamwambia Eliya, "Shuka pamoja naye, wala usimwogope." Eliya akaondoka, akaenda pamoja na kamanda kwa mfalme.

vi.L: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với Ê-li: "Hãy đi xuống với người ấy; đừng sợ người ấy." Ê-li đứng dậy và đi xuống với viên chỉ huy đến gặp vua.
vi.B: Thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo Ê-li: "Hãy đi xuống với người ấy, đừng sợ người ấy." Vậy Ê-li đứng dậy, đi xuống với viên chỉ huy đến gặp vua.
vi.R: Bấy giờ thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} bảo Ê-li: "Hãy đi xuống với người ấy, đừng sợ người ấy." Ê-li đứng dậy và đi với viên chỉ huy đến gặp vua.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 엘리야에게 말했다. "그와 함께 내려가거라. 그를 두려워하지 마라." 그러자 그가 일어나 그와 함께 왕에게로 내려갔다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 엘리야에게 말했다. "그와 함께 내려가거라. 그를 두려워할 것 없다." 그래서 엘리야는 일어나 그와 함께 왕에게 내려갔다.
ko.R: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사가 엘리야에게 말했다. "그와 함께 내려가거라. 그를 두려워하지 마라." 엘리야는 일어나 지휘관과 함께 왕에게 갔다.

decisions.choice: with him ... afraid of him: the third commander
decisions.reason: "Him" most naturally refers to the commander who has just spoken. Elijah has nothing to fear from him or from the king he serves, and he goes down only when Yahweh tells him to, not when the king orders it.

decisions.choice: go down ... went down: Elijah comes down at Yahweh's word
decisions.reason: The king's order "come down" (verses 9 and 11) is carried out only when Yahweh's angel says "go down". Elijah obeys God, not the king.

decisions.choice: with the commander
decisions.reason: Readable names the commander for "him".

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר אֵלָ֜יו כֹּֽה־אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה יַ֜עַן אֲשֶׁר־שָׁלַ֣חְתָּ מַלְאָכִים֮ לִדְרֹשׁ֮ בְּבַ֣עַל זְבוּב֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י עֶקְרוֹן֒ הַֽמִבְּלִ֤י אֵין־אֱלֹהִים֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִדְרֹ֖שׁ בִּדְבָר֑וֹ לָ֠כֵן הַמִּטָּ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־עָלִ֥יתָ שָּׁ֛ם לֹֽא־תֵרֵ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נָּה כִּֽי־מ֥וֹת תָּמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he spoke to him, thus says Yahweh, because that you sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub god of Ekron, [is it] from without [there being] no God in Israel to inquire of his word? Therefore the bed which you have gone up there, not you will come down from it, for dying you will die.

en.L: And he said to him, "Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: Because you sent messengers to inquire of Baal-zebub, [the] god of Ekron, is it because there is no God in Israel to inquire of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word? Therefore the bed that you have gone up on there, you will not come down from it, for you will surely die."
en.B: Elijah said to the king, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: You sent messengers to consult Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron. Did you do that because there is no God in Israel whose word you could seek? Because you did this, you will not come down from the bed you have gone up to; you will certainly die."
en.R: Elijah said to the king, "This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: You sent messengers to ask Baal-zebub, the god of Ekron, for an answer. Is there no God in Israel you could ask for a word? Because you did this, you will never get up from the bed you are lying on. You are sure to die."

es.L: Y le dijo: «Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Por cuanto enviaste mensajeros a consultar a Baal-zebub, dios de Ecrón, ¿es porque no hay Dios en Israel para consultar {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra? Por tanto, de la cama a la que has subido no bajarás, porque ciertamente morirás».
es.B: Elías le dijo al rey: «{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Enviaste mensajeros a consultar a Baal-zebub, el dios de Ecrón. ¿Lo hiciste porque no hay Dios en Israel cuya palabra pudieras buscar? Por haber hecho esto, no bajarás de la cama a la que has subido; ciertamente morirás».
es.R: Elías le dijo al rey: «Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Enviaste mensajeros a pedirle una respuesta a Baal-zebub, el dios de Ecrón. ¿Acaso no hay Dios en Israel a quien pedirle una palabra? Por haber hecho esto, nunca te levantarás de la cama en la que estás acostado. Vas a morir sin remedio».

fr.L: Et il lui dit : « Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Parce que tu as envoyé des messagers consulter Baal-Zeboub, dieu d’Eqrôn, est-ce parce qu’il n’y a pas de Dieu en Israël pour consulter {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole ? C’est pourquoi le lit sur lequel tu es monté, tu n’en descendras pas, car tu mourras certainement. »
fr.B: Élie dit au roi : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : Tu as envoyé des messagers consulter Baal-Zeboub, le dieu d’Eqrôn. L’as-tu fait parce qu’il n’y a pas en Israël de Dieu dont tu puisses demander la parole ? Parce que tu as agi ainsi, tu ne descendras pas du lit où tu es monté ; tu mourras, c’est certain. »
fr.R: Élie a dit au roi : « Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Tu as envoyé des messagers demander une réponse à Baal-Zeboub, le dieu d’Eqrôn. N’y a-t-il pas en Israël un Dieu à qui tu pouvais demander une parole ? Parce que tu as fait cela, tu ne te relèveras jamais du lit où tu es couché. Tu vas mourir, c’est sûr. »

sw.L: Akamwambia, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kwa sababu umetuma wajumbe kwenda kumwuliza Baal-zebubu, mungu wa Ekroni, je, ni kwa sababu hakuna Mungu katika Israeli wa kuliuliza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}? Kwa hiyo kitanda ulichopanda juu yake, hutashuka kutoka kwake, kwa maana hakika utakufa."
sw.B: Eliya akamwambia mfalme, "Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ulituma wajumbe kwenda kumwuliza Baal-zebubu, mungu wa Ekroni. Je, ulifanya hivyo kwa sababu hakuna Mungu katika Israeli ambaye ungeweza kumtafuta akupe neno? Kwa kuwa umefanya hivi, hutashuka kutoka kitanda ulichokipanda; hakika utakufa."
sw.R: Eliya akamwambia mfalme, "Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Ulituma wajumbe kwenda kumwuliza Baal-zebubu, mungu wa Ekroni, akupe jibu. Je, hakuna Mungu katika Israeli ambaye ungemwomba neno? Kwa kuwa umefanya hivi, hutainuka kamwe kutoka kitandani ulicholalia. Hakika utakufa."

vi.L: Ê-li nói với vua: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Vì ngươi đã sai sứ giả đi cầu hỏi Ba-anh Xê-bụt, thần của Éc-rôn, có phải vì không có Đức Chúa Trời trong Y-sơ-ra-ên để cầu hỏi lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sao? Vì vậy, cái giường mà ngươi đã leo lên đó, ngươi sẽ không xuống khỏi nó, vì ngươi chắc chắn sẽ chết."
vi.B: Ê-li nói với vua: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Ngươi đã sai sứ giả đi hỏi ý Ba-anh Xê-bụt, thần của Éc-rôn. Có phải vì Y-sơ-ra-ên không có Đức Chúa Trời để ngươi tìm lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không? Vì ngươi đã làm điều ấy, ngươi sẽ không rời khỏi chiếc giường ngươi đã nằm lên; ngươi chắc chắn phải chết."
vi.R: Ê-li nói với vua: "Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ngươi đã sai sứ giả đi hỏi Ba-anh Xê-bụt, thần của Éc-rôn, để xin một câu trả lời. Y-sơ-ra-ên không có Đức Chúa Trời để ngươi cầu hỏi sao? Vì ngươi đã làm điều ấy, ngươi sẽ không bao giờ ra khỏi giường bệnh nữa. Chắc chắn ngươi sẽ chết."

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하십니다. 네가 에그론의 신 바알세붑에게 물으려고 사자들을 보냈으니, 이스라엘에 그의 말씀을 물을 하나님이 없기 때문이냐? 그러므로 네가 올라가 누운 그 침상에서 너는 내려오지 못할 것이다. 너는 반드시 죽을 것이다."
ko.B: 엘리야가 왕에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하십니다. 너는 에그론의 신 바알세붑에게 물으려고 사자들을 보냈다. 이스라엘에 그 말씀을 여쭐 하나님이 없어서 그렇게 했느냐? 네가 이렇게 했으므로, 너는 올라가 누운 침상에서 내려오지 못하고, 반드시 죽을 것이다."
ko.R: 엘리야가 왕에게 말했다. "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀은 이것입니다. 너는 에그론의 신 바알세붑에게 답을 들으려고 사자들을 보냈다. 이스라엘에는 네가 말씀을 여쭐 하나님이 안 계시냐? 네가 이렇게 했으므로, 너는 지금 누워 있는 침대에서 다시는 일어나지 못할 것이다. 너는 틀림없이 죽을 것이다."

decisions.choice: to inquire of his word: to seek a word from Israel's God
decisions.reason: The third time the question is asked, it is sharper: Israel has a God who speaks, and his word could have been sought. Instead the king sought it from a Philistine god, and now hears Yahweh's word whether he wants it or not.

decisions.choice: because ... therefore: the charge and the sentence
decisions.reason: The verse sets out the wrong ("because you sent") and the judgment ("therefore ... you will surely die"), with the question about the God of Israel between them. It is the message of verses 3-4, now told to the king face to face.

decisions.choice: You sent messengers ... Did you do that because ... Because you did this
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable break the long sentence into short ones and repeat the cause as "Because you did this" before the sentence of death.

decisions.choice: Elijah gives the formula to the king in 합쇼체 ("말씀하십니다"), then speaks God's sentence in God's plain style ("너")
decisions.reason: As the terms note: prophets speak to kings in 합쇼체; God's own words keep 해라체, as Nathan's message does in 2 Samuel 12:7.

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun span for "his word"; "그의 말씀" (L) and "그 말씀" (B)
alternatives: a span as in the English
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; respect for God is carried by the honorific, as the Korean style guide says. This holds through this block.

source.text: וַיָּ֜מָת כִּדְבַ֥ר יְהוָ֣ה׀אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּ֣ר אֵלִיָּ֗הוּ וַיִּמְלֹ֤ךְ יְהוֹרָם֙ תַּחְתָּ֔יופבִּשְׁנַ֣ת שְׁתַּ֔יִם לִיהוֹרָ֥ם בֶּן־יְהוֹשָׁפָ֖ט מֶ֣לֶךְ יְהוּדָ֑ה כִּ֛י לֹֽא־הָ֥יָה ל֖וֹ בֵּֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he died according to [the] word of Yahweh which spoke Elijah; and reigned Jehoram in his place, in [the] year two of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, for not was to him a son.

en.L: And he died according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that Elijah had spoken. And Jehoram reigned in his place, in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah, for he had no son.
en.B: So Ahaziah died, in keeping with the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that Elijah had spoken. Because Ahaziah had no son, Jehoram became king in his place, in the second year of Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat king of Judah.
en.R: So Ahaziah died, just as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had said through Elijah. Ahaziah had no son, so his brother Jehoram became king after him. This was in the second year that Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat was king of Judah.

es.L: Y murió conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que había hablado Elías. Y reinó Jehoram en su lugar, en el año segundo de Jehoram hijo de Josafat, rey de Judá, porque no tenía hijo.
es.B: Así murió Ocozías, conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que Elías había anunciado. Como Ocozías no tenía hijos, Jehoram comenzó a reinar en su lugar, en el segundo año de Jehoram hijo de Josafat, rey de Judá.
es.R: Así murió Ocozías, tal como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo había dicho por medio de Elías. Ocozías no tenía hijos, así que su hermano Jehoram llegó a ser rey después de él. Esto sucedió en el segundo año en que Jehoram hijo de Josafat era rey de Judá.

fr.L: Et il mourut selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’Élie avait prononcée. Et Yehoram régna à sa place, en la deuxième année de Yehoram fils de Josaphat, roi de Juda, car il n’avait pas de fils.
fr.B: Achazia mourut donc, conformément à la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} qu’Élie avait prononcée. Comme Achazia n’avait pas de fils, Yehoram devint roi à sa place, la deuxième année du règne de Yehoram, fils de Josaphat, roi de Juda.
fr.R: Achazia est donc mort, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait annoncé par Élie. Achazia n’avait pas de fils, alors c’est son frère Yehoram qui est devenu roi après lui. C’était la deuxième année du règne de Yehoram, fils de Josaphat, roi de Juda.

sw.L: Akafa sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilolisema Eliya. Yehoramu akatawala mahali pake, katika mwaka wa pili wa Yehoramu mwana wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda, kwa sababu hakuwa na mwana.
sw.B: Basi Ahazia akafa, sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilokuwa amelisema Eliya. Kwa kuwa Ahazia hakuwa na mwana, Yehoramu akawa mfalme mahali pake, katika mwaka wa pili wa Yehoramu mwana wa Yehoshafati mfalme wa Yuda.
sw.R: Basi Ahazia akafa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyosema kupitia Eliya. Ahazia hakuwa na mwana, kwa hiyo ndugu yake Yehoramu akawa mfalme baada yake. Hii ilikuwa katika mwaka wa pili wa utawala wa Yehoramu mwana wa Yehoshafati, mfalme wa Yuda.

vi.L: Vua chết theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà Ê-li đã nói. Giê-hô-ram lên làm vua thay cho vua, vào năm thứ hai đời Giê-hô-ram con trai Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa, vì vua không có con trai.
vi.B: Vậy A-cha-xia qua đời, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà Ê-li đã nói. Vì A-cha-xia không có con trai, Giê-hô-ram lên kế vị, vào năm thứ hai đời Giê-hô-ram con trai Giô-sa-phát vua Giu-đa.
vi.R: Vậy A-cha-xia qua đời, đúng như lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Ê-li. A-cha-xia không có con trai, nên em vua là Giê-hô-ram lên làm vua thay. Đó là năm thứ hai đời Giê-hô-ram con trai Giô-sa-phát làm vua Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 엘리야가 전한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 죽었다. 그리고 그에게 아들이 없었으므로, 유다 왕 여호사밧의 아들 여호람 제2년에 여호람이 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 그래서 아하시야는 엘리야가 전한 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 죽었다. 아하시야에게는 아들이 없었으므로, 유다 왕 여호사밧의 아들 여호람이 다스린 지 2년째 되는 해에 여호람이 그의 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다.
ko.R: 그래서 아하시야는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 엘리야를 통해 말씀하신 대로 죽었다. 아하시야에게는 아들이 없어서 그의 동생 여호람이 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 그때는 여호사밧의 아들 여호람이 유다를 다스린 지 2년째 되는 해였다.

decisions.choice: he died according to the word of Yahweh: the prophecy is fulfilled
decisions.reason: Books of Kings often note that what a prophet said came true (1 Kings 15:29; 16:12, 34). Ahaziah asked a false god whether he would live; Yahweh's word decided the matter.

decisions.choice: two kings named Jehoram
decisions.reason: The new king of Israel is Jehoram son of Ahab, Ahaziah's brother (3:1). At the same time the king of Judah was also called Jehoram, the son of Jehoshaphat (8:16). Both names are spelled the same way here; elsewhere either may appear in the shorter form Joram (8:16, 21; 9:14-15).

decisions.choice: in the second year of Jehoram of Judah: dates that overlap
alternatives: the figures come from different ways of counting the years of a reign
decisions.reason: In 3:1 Jehoram of Israel begins to reign in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat, and in 8:16 Jehoram of Judah begins in the fifth year of Jehoram of Israel. These dates fit together if Jehoram of Judah reigned for some years alongside his father Jehoshaphat before ruling alone. That is the most common way the dates are reconciled, but it is not stated in the text.

decisions.choice: Ahaziah
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Ahaziah for "he" and "him", since two other kings are named in the sentence.

decisions.choice: his brother Jehoram
decisions.reason: Readable says that the new king was Ahaziah's brother, which is why the throne passed to him; 3:1 calls him "Jehoram son of Ahab".

decisions.choice: Jehoram (both kings here)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps the form each verse uses, as the English does: "Jehoram" where the Hebrew has the long form, "Joram" where it has the short one.

decisions.choice: "Yehoram" for both kings here
decisions.reason: The terms note’s form for the spelling Jehoram; where the Hebrew uses the short form (Joram) French writes "Joram", as the English keeps each verse’s form.

decisions.choice: "Giê-hô-ram" for both kings
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives both kings the long form here, so Vietnamese keeps "Giê-hô-ram" for both, as the terms note keeps each verse's form (Giê-hô-ram / Giô-ram); the meaning decision m2 explains that they are two kings.

decisions.choice: "em vua"
decisions.reason: Readable must say whether the brother is older or younger; Jehoram was Ahaziah's younger brother, the next son of Ahab to reign.

decisions.choice: The reason "for he had no son" moves before the accession in Korean; numbers of years are figures ("제2년", "2년째")
alternatives: keeping the clause at the end
decisions.reason: Korean puts a cause before the clause it explains. The regnal year follows the terms note's formula; figures keep dates easy to compare across the two kingdoms.

decisions.choice: "그의 동생 여호람" at Readable
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "his brother"; Korean must choose older or younger. Jehoram, another son of Ahab (3:1), followed his brother, and is taken as the younger.

source.text: וְיֶ֛תֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י אֲחַזְיָ֖הוּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה הֲלֽוֹא־הֵ֣מָּה כְתוּבִ֗ים עַל־סֵ֛פֶר דִּבְרֵ֥י הַיָּמִ֖ים לְמַלְכֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Ahaziah which he did, [are] not they written on [the] book of [the] matters of the days of [the] kings of Israel?

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Ahaziah that he did, are they not written in the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel?
en.B: The rest of the acts of Ahaziah, what he did, are written in the Book of the History of the Kings of Israel.
en.R: Everything else Ahaziah did is written in the history of the kings of Israel.

es.L: Y los demás hechos de Ocozías, lo que hizo, ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel?
es.B: Los demás hechos de Ocozías, lo que hizo, están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel.
es.R: Todo lo demás que hizo Ocozías está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Achazia, ce qu’il fit, n’est-il pas écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël ?
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Achazia, ce qu’il fit, est écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Achazia a fait d’autre a été écrit dans le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Ahazia aliyoyafanya, je, hayajaandikwa katika kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli?
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Ahazia, aliyoyafanya, yameandikwa katika Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya Ahazia yameandikwa katika historia ya wafalme wa Israeli.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-cha-xia, những gì vua đã làm, chẳng phải đã được chép trong sách ghi chép các việc thời các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên sao?
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-cha-xia, những gì vua đã làm, đều được chép trong Sách Lịch Sử Các Vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-cha-xia đã làm đều được chép trong sách lịch sử các vua Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 아하시야가 행한 나머지 일들은 이스라엘 왕들의 시대의 일을 적은 책에 기록되어 있지 않으냐?
ko.B: 아하시야의 나머지 행적, 곧 그가 한 일은 이스라엘 왕 실록에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아하시야가 한 다른 모든 일은 이스라엘 왕들의 역사를 적은 책에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Israel: a royal record the writer used
decisions.reason: This is not the biblical book of Chronicles but a record of the reigns of the kings of the northern kingdom, now lost. The writer of Kings refers to it for further details of each reign, as throughout 1 Kings (first at 1 Kings 14:19).

decisions.choice: the Hebrew ends Ahaziah's reign here
decisions.reason: The Greek translation adds after this verse a summary of the reign of Jehoram of Israel, much like 3:1-3. The Hebrew text, which gives that summary in 3:1-3 only, is followed.

decisions.choice: a statement at Balanced and Readable
decisions.reason: The question "are they not written ...?" expects the answer yes. Literal keeps the question; Balanced and Readable state the fact, as throughout Kings.

decisions.choice: ¿no están escritos en el libro de los hechos de los días de los reyes de Israel? (Literal); están escritos en el libro de la Historia de los Reyes de Israel (Balanced); está escrito en la historia de los reyes de Israel (Readable)
alternatives: Crónicas de los reyes de Israel
decisions.reason: The source formula takes the one wording of the terms note at each level through Kings: a question at Literal, a statement at Balanced and Readable. "Historia" keeps the royal record apart from the book of Chronicles.

decisions.choice: "le livre des Annales des rois d’Israël"
alternatives: "le livre des Chroniques des rois d’Israël"
decisions.reason: As the Kings terms note: "Annales", so that the source is not confused with the book of Chronicles; a question at L, a statement at B and R.

decisions.choice: "kitabu cha mambo ya siku za wafalme wa Israeli" (Literal); "Kitabu cha Historia ya Wafalme wa Israeli" (Balanced); "historia ya wafalme wa Israeli" (Readable)
alternatives: "Kitabu cha Mambo ya Nyakati za Wafalme wa Israeli"
decisions.reason: The royal record is not called "Mambo ya Nyakati", the usual Swahili title of the books of Chronicles, so that readers do not take it for the biblical book. Literal follows the Hebrew words "the matters of the days".
